note: OMIM #621182 is formally defined by poor/absent speech, dysmorphic facies, and behavioral abnormalities linked to NAV3 variants, supporting speech and behavioral hallmarks as key distinguishing features.

evidence.text: A biallelic missense variant in NAV3 was reported in association with autosomal recessive neurodevelopmental disorder (OMIM: 621182), noting speech abnormalities as a distinctive feature in the clinical phenotype.

source.title: NAV3 Missense Variant in a Homozygous State: Strengthening Links to Neurodevelopmental Disorder
